description: FIX_STAY_ENGAGED (ships OFF): an engaged unit that would fall back by default compares staying engaged with falling back and stays when staying is worth more — 11e 12.04: in our own Fight phase we select first when nobody has Fights First, so a unit locked with one it wipes strikes first; 09.07: after a fall back it could not shoot, charge or start an action anyway. Same position as exam mv08: Custodian Guard Alpha is locked off every objective with four Prosecutors (11.6 damage against 4 wounds). With tests/bench_profiles/stay_engaged_on.json loaded, clicking the real Suggest (K) button shows 'Custodian Guard Alpha stays engaged with Prosecutors (wipes them out in our Fight phase; …)', the 'How this turn's move was shaped' note 'Wipes out Prosecutors in our own Fight phase …' and the engaged_choice ledger ('Out-fight it'). Clearing the profile restores the shipped default: 'Custodian Guard Alpha falls back (not on objective)', no note, no record. Reloading restores the stay; executing it leaves the squad unmoved and engaged on the engine. The guard pair: our Prosecutors, locked with Allarus Custodians that kill them, are suggested a fall back ('staying would cost 4.0 wounds …'), which staged through AIPlayer ends unengaged.
